description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for a Todo creation and editing form screen. It manages user input for Todo title, description, and completion status, and interacts with a TodoProvider to save changes.

classes.name: TodoFormScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a form interface for creating or editing a Todo item.

classes.name: _TodoFormScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the form state, user input, and submission logic for the TodoFormScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the form controllers and populates them if an existing Todo is being edited.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the text controllers when the widget is removed from the tree.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Validates form input and calls the provider to add or update a Todo; handles UI feedback like showing snackbars.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the Todo form interface, including input fields, buttons, and layout.
